description: Write out everything said in a recording, with the exact second every word starts and ends. Give it the asset id of a clip in your library (or an https link) and you get back the full text, the language it heard, and a word-by-word list with times you can build captions or cut on. Set speakers true when more than one person is talking and each word is also labelled with who said it. Set sound_events true to have laughter, applause and other noises marked too. Works on audio and on video files. Billed per minute of the recording (a charge applies). Nothing new is saved to your library.

language.description: Optional two-letter language code, e.g. "en". Leave out and the language is worked out automatically.

recording.description: The clip to write out: an asset id from your library, or an https link.

sound_events.description: Optional. true marks non-speech sounds like laughter and applause.

speakers.description: Optional. true labels each word with who said it, for two or more people talking.

name: transcribe_audio
title: Transcribe Audio
